guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：穿透電子顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Transmission electron microscopes
guides.concept: 以 300 kV 穿透電子顯微鏡為對象：從 1.97 pm 的電子波長與布拉格繞射出發，推導 Scherzer 解析度、對比傳遞函數與色像差資訊極限，理解六極 Cs 校正器為何把解析度推到 0.1 nm 以下，再把高壓與透鏡電流的 ppm 級穩定度、樣品厚度與撞擊損傷、場址環境與驗收測試整合成可交付的工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Taking a 300 kV transmission electron microscope: start from the 1.97 pm electron wavelength and Bragg diffraction, derive Scherzer resolution, the contrast transfer function and the chromatic information limit, see why a hexapole Cs corrector pushes resolution below 0.1 nm, then integrate ppm-level high-voltage and lens-current stability, specimen thickness and knock-on damage, site environment and acceptance tests into a deliverable engineering record.
procedure: 穿透電子顯微鏡讓高能電子穿過厚度數十奈米的薄樣品，物鏡把透射與散射電子在後焦面形成繞射圖、在像平面形成影像，後續的中間鏡與投影鏡選擇放大哪一個平面。對比有三種來源：質量厚度對比來自被物鏡光圈擋掉的高角散射；繞射對比來自晶體特定取向滿足布拉格條件；相位對比來自透射束與繞射束在像平面的干涉，是晶格影像的基礎。300 kV 的電子波長只有 1.97 pm，布拉格角只有幾個毫弧度，所以整個光學系統在極小角度內工作，像差成為主要限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

薄樣品是弱相位物體，影像對比由對比傳遞函數 CTF(u) = sin χ(u) 決定，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴，u 是空間頻率。球面像差 C_s 讓相位隨 u⁴ 快速振盪，CTF 在第一個過零點之後正負交替，影像不再直觀；Scherzer 離焦把 Δf 選成讓低頻段形成最寬的負值通帶，第一個過零點定義點解析度。六極或八極 Cs 校正器產生負的球面像差抵銷物鏡的正值，使 C_s 可調到接近零甚至微負，過零點外推到色像差資訊極限，解析度由 0.17 nm 進入 0.1 nm 以下，並消除離域效應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

校正球面像差後，解析度受色像差控制的時間相干性限制：電子能量散佈 ΔE、高壓漣波 ΔV/V 與物鏡電流漣波 ΔI/I 都讓焦距抖動，疊加成焦距散佈 Δ = C_c·√((ΔE/E)² + (ΔV/V)² + (2ΔI/I)²)，高頻資訊因此被阻尼包絡壓掉。所以 300 kV 的高壓發生器放在絕緣氣體槽內以 ppm 等級穩壓，透鏡電源用高精度電流源與恆溫，Schottky 槍的 0.7 eV 散佈成為最大項；需要更高極限時加單色器把散佈壓到 0.2 eV 以下，代價是損失大部分電流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高壓槽、Schottky 槍與單色器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

物鏡的 C_s 與 C_c 隨極靴間隙縮小而降低，但間隙也限制樣品傾轉角度與分析偵測器的空間，高解析極靴通常只允許 ±20° 到 ±35° 的傾轉。校正器由兩組六極與傳遞透鏡組成，六極產生的三階負球面像差抵銷物鏡，但同時引入必須以多個偏轉與弱透鏡抵銷的寄生像差，整組需要數十個電源在毫安等級下保持 ppm 穩定。樣品載台在真空中以側插式桿承載，熱漂移與機械鬆弛決定曝光期間的位移。偵測器從閃爍體耦合 CMOS 走向直接電子偵測，後者以計數模式把偵測量子效率提升到接近 1，並允許以短幀對齊消除漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡極靴、六極校正器與直接偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

影像上的長度尺度由物鏡與投影鏡的激磁決定，隨放大率檔位、高壓與鏡體溫度變化，必須以晶格間距已知的樣品校正：高倍用矽 (111) 0.3136 nm 或 (220) 0.1920 nm 晶格條紋，中低倍用溝槽光柵複製膜或奈米顆粒標準片；繞射模式的相機長度用多晶金環校正。像差量測本身也要校正：Zemlin 表假設束傾角已知，而束傾角由偏轉線圈的校正係數決定，所以先用繞射點位移校正偏轉線圈，再量像差。所有校正值都綁定高壓、放大率檔位與極靴，換任一項就要重做。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽晶格與金環校正樣品」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高解析成像要求樣品厚度在 10 到 50 nm，電子在樣品內的非彈性平均自由徑約 100 nm 等級，厚度與自由徑之比 t/λ 可由能量損失譜的零損失峰與總強度之比求得，是每張影像都應記錄的參數。電子束同時損傷樣品：撞擊位移發生在電子能把超過位移閾值的能量傳給原子核時，最大傳遞能量隨加速電壓升高而增加，輕元素最敏感；電離損傷則對高分子與某些氧化物主導，隨電壓降低反而變嚴重。因此加速電壓是依樣品而選的參數，不是越高越好。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「樣品厚度、劑量與撞擊損傷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

像差校正顯微鏡的解析度與穩定度綁在一起，場址必須把干擾壓到影像週期的十分之一以下：交流雜散磁場偏轉電子束並以電源頻率抖動影像；室溫漂移改變透鏡線圈電阻與鏡筒長度，使焦點與放大率緩慢漂移；地板振動與聲壓直接搖動樣品相對於物鏡的位置。對策包含鏡筒外的磁屏蔽與主動磁場消除、±0.1 °C 的房間溫控與鏡筒水冷恆溫、主動隔振基座與隔音外罩，以及把電子設備與操作者移到隔壁房間以遠端操作。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡筒外罩、磁場消除與溫控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收必須用可重複的客觀指標：資訊極限以非晶材料的 Young 條紋量到的最高空間頻率表示；點解析度以矽 [110] 的 0.136 nm 啞鈴是否分開、或以 STEM-HAADF 影像中原子柱的傅立葉峰表示；穩定度以校正後的像差表在 30 分鐘內保持在容限內、以及高壓與透鏡電流的紀錄表示。EELS 與 EDS 另有能量解析度與偵測效率的驗收項。交接文件包含每個高壓與極靴組合的校正表、像差校正程序、場址環境紀錄、樣品損傷指引與每週的穩定度例行檢查，讓後續使用者能判斷儀器是否仍在驗收狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Young 條紋、啞鈴影像與驗收清單」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A transmission electron microscope sends high-energy electrons through a specimen tens of nanometres thick; the objective lens forms a diffraction pattern in its back focal plane and an image in the image plane, and intermediate and projector lenses choose which plane to magnify. Contrast has three origins: mass-thickness contrast from high-angle scattering stopped by the objective aperture; diffraction contrast from crystal orientations satisfying Bragg's condition; and phase contrast from interference of transmitted and diffracted beams in the image plane, the basis of lattice imaging. At 300 kV the electron wavelength is only 1.97 pm and Bragg angles are a few milliradians, so the whole optical system works within tiny angles and aberrations become the dominant limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A thin specimen is a weak phase object whose image contrast follows the contrast transfer function CTF(u) = sin χ(u) with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴ and u the spatial frequency. Spherical aberration C_s makes the phase oscillate rapidly with u⁴, so beyond the first zero the CTF alternates sign and the image stops being intuitive; Scherzer defocus chooses Δf to form the widest negative passband at low frequency, and the first zero defines point resolution. A hexapole or octupole Cs corrector produces negative spherical aberration to cancel the objective's positive value, letting C_s be tuned near zero or slightly negative, pushing the first zero out to the chromatic information limit, taking resolution from 0.17 nm to below 0.1 nm and removing delocalisation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

With spherical aberration corrected, resolution is bounded by temporal coherence governed by chromatic aberration: energy spread ΔE, high-voltage ripple ΔV/V and objective-current ripple ΔI/I each jitter the focus and combine into a focal spread Δ = C_c·√((ΔE/E)² + (ΔV/V)² + (2ΔI/I)²), and a damping envelope suppresses high-frequency information. The 300 kV generator therefore sits in an insulating-gas tank regulated at the ppm level, lens supplies use precision current sources in temperature-controlled housings, and the 0.7 eV spread of a Schottky gun becomes the largest term; a monochromator brings the spread below 0.2 eV when a higher limit is needed, at the cost of most of the current. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-voltage tank, Schottky gun and monochromator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Objective C_s and C_c fall as the pole-piece gap shrinks, but the gap also limits specimen tilt and room for analytical detectors, so high-resolution pole pieces usually allow only ±20° to ±35° of tilt. The corrector consists of two hexapole groups with transfer lenses; the hexapoles create negative third-order spherical aberration that cancels the objective's, but introduce parasitic aberrations that must be nulled with many deflectors and weak lenses, so dozens of supplies must stay ppm-stable at milliamp levels. The specimen rides a side-entry holder in vacuum, and its thermal drift and mechanical relaxation set the displacement during exposure. Detectors have moved from scintillator-coupled CMOS to direct electron detection, whose counting mode raises detective quantum efficiency toward 1 and allows drift removal by aligning short frames. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective pole piece, hexapole corrector and direct detector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Image scale depends on objective and projector excitation and changes with magnification step, high voltage and column temperature, so it is calibrated with specimens of known lattice spacing: silicon (111) 0.3136 nm or (220) 0.1920 nm fringes at high magnification, replica gratings or nanoparticle standards at lower magnification; camera length in diffraction mode is calibrated with polycrystalline gold rings. Aberration measurement must itself be calibrated: a Zemlin tableau assumes known beam tilts, which depend on deflector calibration coefficients, so deflectors are first calibrated from diffraction-spot shifts and only then are aberrations measured. Every calibration value is bound to high voltage, magnification step and pole piece, and changing any one requires redoing it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Silicon lattice and gold-ring calibration specimens”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

High-resolution imaging needs specimens 10 to 50 nm thick; the inelastic mean free path is of order 100 nm, and the ratio t/λ, obtained from the zero-loss to total intensity ratio in an energy-loss spectrum, is a parameter that should be recorded with every image. The beam also damages the specimen: knock-on displacement occurs when an electron can transfer more than the displacement threshold to a nucleus, and the maximum transferable energy rises with accelerating voltage, light elements being most sensitive; radiolysis dominates in polymers and some oxides and worsens as voltage falls. Accelerating voltage is therefore chosen per specimen, not simply maximised. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Specimen thickness, dose and knock-on damage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Aberration-corrected microscopes tie resolution to stability, and the site must hold disturbances below a tenth of the image period: ac stray fields deflect the beam and jitter the image at mains frequency; room-temperature drift changes lens-coil resistance and column length so focus and magnification creep; floor vibration and sound pressure shake the specimen relative to the objective. Countermeasures include magnetic shielding and active field cancellation around the column, ±0.1 °C room control with temperature-stabilised lens cooling water, an active isolation base, acoustic enclosures, and moving electronics and operators to an adjacent room for remote operation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Column enclosure, field cancellation and temperature control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance uses repeatable objective indicators: the information limit as the highest spatial frequency in Young's fringes on amorphous material; point resolution as whether the 0.136 nm silicon [110] dumbbells separate, or as Fourier peaks of atomic columns in STEM-HAADF images; stability as the corrected aberration table staying within tolerance for 30 minutes together with high-voltage and lens-current logs. EELS and EDS add energy-resolution and detection-efficiency items. The handoff package contains calibration tables for every high-voltage and pole-piece combination, the aberration-correction procedure, site environment records, specimen-damage guidance and a weekly stability routine, so later users can judge whether the instrument is still in its accepted state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Young's fringes, dumbbell images and acceptance checklist”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 樣品厚度超過 100 nm 時多重散射與非彈性散射主導，晶格影像的相位對比消失、繞射點被動力學效應改寫，分析者用運動學公式解讀點強度而得到錯誤的結構結論。
用 200 kV 時建立的放大率表在切換到 300 kV 後繼續使用，透鏡激磁不同使比例差 4%，奈米顆粒粒徑統計全部偏小，論文發表後才被同行以 X 光繞射結果質疑。
pitfallsEn: A specimen thicker than 100 nm is dominated by multiple and inelastic scattering, lattice phase contrast vanishes and spot intensities are rewritten by dynamical effects; interpreting them with kinematic formulas yields wrong structural conclusions.

A magnification table built at 200 kV is kept after switching to 300 kV; different lens excitation shifts the scale by 4%, every nanoparticle size statistic reads small, and the discrepancy is raised by peers with X-ray diffraction results only after publication.

related.title: 掃描電子顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「電子波長、散射與對比機制」與「放大率、相機長度與像差量測的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；掃描電子顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms" and "Calibrating magnification, camera length and aberration measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scanning electron microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦300 kV 電子波長、相位對比傳遞函數、Cs 校正與資訊極限的穩定度工程；掃描電子顯微鏡則以電子探針直徑預算、Everhart–Thornley 偵測、作用體積與放大率校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on 300 kV electron wavelength, phase-contrast transfer function, Cs correction and the stability engineering behind the information limit; Scanning electron microscopes centres on probe-diameter budget, Everhart–Thornley detection, interaction volume and magnification calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes” and “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”.

related.title: 低溫電子顯微鏡
related.transfer: 可遷移「電子波長、散射與對比機制」與「放大率、相機長度與像差量測的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；低溫電子顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms" and "Calibrating magnification, camera length and aberration measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Cryogenic electron microscopes must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦300 kV 電子波長、相位對比傳遞函數、Cs 校正與資訊極限的穩定度工程；低溫電子顯微鏡則以玻璃態冰、低劑量相位對比、CTF 與 Ewald 球修正、直接偵測器與設施級產出為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on 300 kV electron wavelength, phase-contrast transfer function, Cs correction and the stability engineering behind the information limit; Cryogenic electron microscopes centres on vitreous ice, low-dose phase contrast, CTF and Ewald-sphere correction, direct detectors and facility-scale throughput, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」與「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到低溫電子顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「Ewald 球修正、束致漂移與高階像差」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes” and “Vitreous ice and the dose budget”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cryogenic electron microscopes, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ewald-sphere correction, beam-induced motion and higher-order aberrations", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 穿透電子顯微鏡
history.text: 1931 年 Ruska 與 Knoll 在柏林建造第一台電子顯微鏡，1933 年超越光學顯微鏡的解析度；Scherzer 在 1936 年證明圓對稱靜電磁透鏡的球面像差不可能為負，使像差成為此後六十年的極限。1990 年代 Rose 提出六極校正器方案，Haider、Rose 與 Urban 在 1998 年於 200 kV 儀器上實證 Cs 校正，隨後 CEOS 與各大廠把校正器商品化，300 kV 儀器的資訊極限進入 0.05 到 0.08 nm；單色器、直接電子偵測器與 ppm 級電源使穩定度工程成為今日高解析電子顯微鏡的核心。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Ruska and Knoll built the first electron microscope in Berlin in 1931 and surpassed light-microscope resolution in 1933; Scherzer proved in 1936 that rotationally symmetric electrostatic and magnetic lenses cannot have negative spherical aberration, making aberration the limit for the next sixty years. In the 1990s Rose proposed the hexapole corrector, Haider, Rose and Urban demonstrated Cs correction on a 200 kV instrument in 1998, CEOS and the major makers then commercialised correctors, and the information limit of 300 kV instruments reached 0.05 to 0.08 nm; monochromators, direct electron detectors and ppm-level supplies made stability engineering the core of today's high-resolution electron microscopy. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「電子波長、散射與對比機制」到「解析度驗收、穩定度驗證與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Electron wavelength, scattering and contrast mechanisms" through "Resolution acceptance, stability validation and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
